purpose: Cross-link Portfolio Risk sizing claims to existing Trading Frictions evidence semantics without inventing a new cost model.
prerequisites: confirmed fill positively attributed to durable signal
same selected names and planned deployment for comparator
untriggered planned capital explicitly remains cash
attributed terminal fill OR predeclared fixed execution horizon with valid mark

costLayers.commission: ACTUAL / PARTIAL_ACTUAL / MODELED / UNKNOWN; account-specific; UNKNOWN never zero
costLayers.tax: ACTUAL / PARTIAL_ACTUAL / MODELED / UNKNOWN; trade class/date must support the rate
costLayers.slippage: ACTUAL when signal-linked confirmed fill supplies price/time; otherwise MODELED only under a predeclared scenario or UNKNOWN

namingFirewall: Any modeled component prevents ACTUAL_NET_EXECUTION label.
Missing commission prevents NET_EXPLICIT and NET_ALL_IN labels.
Missing slippage may still permit NET_EXPLICIT if commission and tax are evidenced/modelled, but not NET_ALL_IN.
No order receipt is required merely for linked fill slippage; it is required for fill-probability/partial-fill claims.
